title: Why Does Popcorn Pop?
description: Why does popcorn pop? The simple science of steam pressure inside a tiny kernel.
comment: Sweet or salty popcorn? Tell me below!

scenes.text: Why does a hard little corn kernel suddenly pop?
Inside each kernel is a tiny drop of water, locked in by a tough shell.
When it heats up, that water turns into steam, and the pressure builds up.
At around one hundred and eighty degrees, the shell cracks, and the starch inside bursts out and puffs up.
Very dry or old kernels have lost their water, so many stay unpopped.
So keep your kernels in a sealed jar.
